title: Point pendulum on a distance joint: period against the XPBD modified equation, first-order convergence to the exact elliptic period

tol.derivation: |T - T_mod| / T_exact <= 5/24 (w0 h)^2 + rounding, T_mod from the modified equation theta'' = -(g/L) sin - h (theta'^3 + (g/L) cos theta'); 5/24 is the scheme's second-order period remainder of the linearized equation (f64 analysis in docs/P2-02); rounding: per substep 2 quanta of fixed point and 2u of the f32 step, as time at the zero crossing, plus the energy random walk of velocity rounding (5 x 4u sqrt(substeps), Higham 2002 §3.4) times d ln T / d ln E; residual 8u L (the 1 m offset to the anchor is rounded once per substep)
tol.source: Hairer, Lubich, Wanner, Geometric Numerical Integration, ch. IX (modified equations); exact period 4 sqrt(L/g) K(sin(theta0/2))
